answer_2.quote: We adopted the following automatic metrics to evaluate the performance on the test sets. (1) BLEU-1 (B-1): The metric computes n-gram overlap between generated texts and human-written texts . ( ) Reverse-BLEU-1 (rB-1): The metric measures the recall of generated n-grams . ( ) BLEU-1-R (B-1-R) and (4) Reverse-BLEU-1-R (rB-1-R): These two metrics denote that stop words in the generated and referenced text are filtered first, and then the B-1 and rB-1 are computed, respectively. (5) Distinctn: We use n = 4, 5 to measure the generation diversity .

answer_4.quote: We hired three proficient English speakers as human evaluators to give a preference (win, lose, or tie) in terms of relevance and coherence, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Relevance measures whether the generation is related to the prompt. Coherence measures whether the generation revolves around the same topic and the transition across sentences is natural and smooth.
